# Project Canon

> Project Canon is one block of rules for a repository's AGENTS.md or
> CLAUDE.md that tells coding agents where each kind of knowledge
> belongs, and keeps the few things code, tests and git cannot hold in a
> handful of flat notes in canon/.

Most of what an agent needs already has a home: behavior and limits in
code and tests, the reason for a change in its commit body, local
oddities in a comment, procedures in the runbook beside the tool, working
rules in the instruction file. A Canon note holds only a guarantee that
spans several owners, an accepted gap, a measured dead end, or an
owner-approved plan for unbuilt work. Agents read nothing in canon/ at
session start; a task that touches a note's subject lists canon/ and
reads the matching note. The owner's current instruction outranks every
note. There are no decision records, no front matter or stamps, no index,
and no checker: canon/ is flat, at most twelve notes of about a thousand
words unless the owner sets other numbers, kept small by rule.

The rules changed on field evidence. An adopter of the earlier, larger
Canon (manifest read first, stamped front matter, immutable decision
records, per-feature specs) at production scale. In its last 30 days
canon/ was touched in 488 of 639 commits, and about half of all canon
file touches were stamp bumps; at migration it held 384 files, about 200k
words and 272 decision records. A typical fix was estimated to read about
23k tokens of canon before any code. An approval record reverted finished
work 18 minutes after it landed. After a one-time migration its canon is
four notes.

Install: copy dist/AGENTS.md from https://github.com/stefan-vatov/canon to AGENTS.md (a managed block between BEGIN/END PROJECT CANON markers; project rules go outside it); for Claude Code, make CLAUDE.md import it with an @AGENTS.md line; never overwrite an existing file, merge the block instead (INSTALL.md)
Version: Not stated in repository
License: MIT
Runtime: any agent that reads AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md (Codex, Pi, Claude Code); the repository's own build and eval tools run via uv (Python 3.10+)
Docs: https://agentcanon.dev/
Source: https://github.com/stefan-vatov/canon
Maintainer: Stefan Vatov

## Quickstart

```bash
(
  set -eu
  for f in AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md; do
    if test -e "$f" || test -L "$f"; then
      echo "$f exists: merge the block instead (INSTALL.md, managed merge)" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  done
  tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/stefan-vatov/canon "$tmp/canon"
  cp "$tmp/canon/dist/AGENTS.md" AGENTS.md
  printf '@AGENTS.md\n' > CLAUDE.md   # omit if Claude Code does not work here
)
# in a fresh agent session: "Set up Project Canon in this repository; write no notes."
```

## Why Project Canon

- The shipped block is about 700 words, generated from canon-core.md by
  tools/build.py into dist/AGENTS.md and dist/CLAUDE.md.
- Fifteen evaluation scenarios under evals/scenarios/ test the current
  rules, including a decision that must leave no record, an owner
  instruction that overrides a note's "never" rule, and a code-only task
  that must read no Canon. The new set has not yet been run against live
  models; earlier scores in evals/BASELINES.md measure the retired core.
- Nothing runs in an adopter's hooks or CI.

## Questions Agents Ask

**What is Project Canon?** One block of rules in AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md
plus a handful of flat notes in canon/ for what code, tests and git
cannot tell you. Nothing in canon/ is read at session start.

**Should I record a decision?** Not as a record. Implement it, put the
reason and the rejected alternative in the commit body, and, only if it
constrains future work in a way code cannot show, add one clause to the
document it constrains. A reversal edits that clause in place.

**What if a note disagrees with the owner?** The owner wins. Say once
that the note disagrees, do what was asked, and fix or delete the note in
the same change. A note cannot grant permission or veto the owner.

**When must I edit Canon?** When your change makes a Canon sentence
false, or changes a guarantee, contract or accepted gap a note states.
Moves, renames and refactors oblige nothing.

**Can an agent fill in a missing policy or limit?** No. Stop the
policy-dependent work and report the exact gap; do not implement, test
or record a guess.

- [Repository](https://github.com/stefan-vatov/canon): core, generated

## Optional

- [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/stefan-vatov/canon/blob/main/INSTALL.md): managed merges, the CLAUDE.md import, bootstrap, migration, upgrades, rollback, uninstall
- [compact-canon skill](https://github.com/stefan-vatov/canon/blob/main/.codex/skills/compact-canon/SKILL.md): a one-time migration for a canon built under the older rules; dry run available; remove it afterwards
- [canon-core.md](https://github.com/stefan-vatov/canon/blob/main/canon-core.md): the exact shared block
- [Evaluation harness](https://github.com/stefan-vatov/canon/tree/main/evals): scenarios, rubric, playbook, baselines

If you remember one line: Project Canon keeps in canon/ only what code,
tests and git cannot say, reads none of it up front, records no
decisions, and lets the owner's current word outrank every note.
